subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter options, and secure transfer details
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@acmecorp.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acmecorp.com
Date: 2026-01-12T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request and transfer options

Hi Naomi,

Hope you're well. We're updating our vendor assurance pack for an internal audit and need the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and any available bridge letter for coverage gaps. Our audit period is calendar 2025 (01/01/2025 - 12/31/2025). Can you confirm: 

- Do you have a Type II report that covers any portion of that window?
- If your report period doesn't fully cover calendar 2025, can you provide a bridge letter or attestation that details which months are covered and the controls mapping?
- Preferred secure transfer method for report/evidence (S3 presigned link, secure Drive folder, or vendor portal)?

Also — can you provide a quick list of the minimal artifacts our procurement team will want (e.g., retention policy, sample access logs, admin access matrix)? If possible, a short email template we can attach to our procurement request would be super helpful.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reynolds
Director, Vendor Security
Acme Corp

P.S. We may need the report in two business days — let me know if that's feasible or whether we should expect a short lead time.

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-01-12T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and transfer options

Hi Tom — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes, we can share our most recent SOC 2 Type II report and we can provide a bridge letter to clarify exact coverage. A few clarifying points and options so we can get you the right package quickly: 

1) Coverage window: our latest Type II report covers July 1, 2024 — June 30, 2025 (audit period: 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30). That overlaps the first half of your 2025 calendar year but does not extend through Dec 31, 2025.

2) Bridge letter options (pick one):
  - Option A: Formal bridge letter confirming that the controls environment remained materially unchanged from July 1, 2025 through Dec 31, 2025 (requires attestation by our security lead and may need additional evidence).
  - Option B: Period-mapping letter that states the actual Type II period we cover and enumerates which controls were assessed; we can supply control mappings to common frameworks (SIG/CAIQ) to help you close the gap on your side.
  - Option C: Report + short control snapshot (sample logs, retention policy, admin matrix) for the missing months to supplement the report.

3) Transfer methods we support:
  - Secure S3 presigned URL (preferred for bulk packages) — we can provide a time-limited zip.
  - Google Drive folder with restricted sharing.
  - Secure vendor portal (requires onboarding) or encrypted e-mail upon request.

4) Minimal artifact list (we will include these by default if you pick Option B/C):
  - SOC 2 Type II report PDF (signed)
  - Bridge letter (docx/pdf)
  - Data retention policy (pdf)
  - Sample admin access matrix (csv)
  - Redacted access logs sample (csv)
  - Control mapping to SIG/CAIQ (xlsx)

If you can confirm which bridge option you prefer and your transfer choice, we'll prepare the package. If you need the documents within 2 business days, choose S3 presigned transfer and Option B (period-mapping) — we'll prioritize that.

Cc'ing Marissa (assurance) and Ben (legal/compliance) to help assemble the artifacts.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024-07-01_2025-06-30.pdf (signed report) — will be the primary artifact.
- Bridge_Letter_Sample.docx — editable template we can customize for Option A or B.
- data-retention-policy.pdf — current policy snapshot.
- access-logs-sample.csv — 7-day sample redacted for PII.

Notes / constraints:

- Redaction: we will redact internal hostnames and user identifiers in log extracts; if Acme needs unredacted material for an audit, we will require an NDA amendment.

Transfer plan: I will stage a password-protected zip on S3 and deliver a presigned link valid for 72 hours. If Tom confirms S3, we'll proceed and I will include a short procurement-friendly email template.

Marissa
Sr. Assurance Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Tom — following up with the plan and a couple of quick templates you can paste into your procurement ticket. We have the report ready and will stage the S3 link when you confirm.

S3 transfer: https://s3.amazonaws.com/presigned-placeholder/Redwood-SOC2.zip (will be replaced with live presigned URL; expires 72 hours)

One-line procurement template (copy into your ticket):
"Redwood Inference — please provide SOC 2 Type II report and related artifacts (data retention policy, admin access matrix, redacted logs, and SIG/CAIQ control mapping). Preferred transfer: S3 presigned link. Contact: Naomi Feldman (naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com)."

Bridge letter suggested wording (short form — Option B):
"This letter confirms that the Redwood Inference SOC 2 Type II examination covers the period July 1, 2024 through June 30, 2025. The controls evaluated during that period are described in the attached report. To support requests for evidence outside that period, Redwood has provided a mapped control snapshot and sample artifacts for the subsequent months. This bridge information is provided for informational purposes only and does not constitute an extension of the auditor's opinion beyond the report period."

If you want Option A (formal attestation that nothing material changed after the report period), please let us know and we'll route to Legal; expected lead time 3-5 business days.

I'll send the S3 link and attach the report once you confirm S3 is acceptable.

Best,
Naomi
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
